description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceInfo plugin and related components, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests various RPC methods such as 'systeminfo', 'addresses', 'firmwareversion', 'make', 'modelname', 'devicetype', and hardware support inquiries. The tests mock dependencies and verify JSON responses for the DeviceInfo plugin functionality.

classes.name: DeviceInfoJsonRpcTest
classes.description: Base test fixture class for DeviceInfo RPC tests, setting up plugin, handler, connection, and response.

classes.name: DeviceInfoJsonRpcInitializedTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture that initializes mocks for system info and management components before each test.

classes.name: DeviceInfoJsonRpcInitializedDsTest
classes.description: Extends previous fixture, adding mocks for device hardware interfaces like host, audio, video resolutions, and ports.

classes.name: DeviceInfoJsonRpcInitializedDsVideoOutputTest
classes.description: Further extends device mocks to include video output port configurations and types.

methods.name: registeredMethods
methods.description: Tests that specific RPC methods are registered and recognized by the handler.

methods.name: systeminfo
methods.description: Tests the 'systeminfo' RPC method, mocks system call, and verifies JSON response structure.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Tests the 'addresses' RPC method and checks response format containing network address info.

methods.name: socketinfo
methods.description: Tests the 'socketinfo' RPC method, expecting a JSON with run count.

methods.name: firmwareversion
methods.description: Reads version info from a file, invokes the RPC, and verifies correct JSON response with version details.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Reads device manufacturer info from a file, invokes corresponding RPC, and verifies manufacturer name in JSON response.

methods.name: modelname
methods.description: Reads device model info from a file, invokes RPC, and verifies model name in JSON.

methods.name: devicetype
methods.description: Reads device type configuration from a file, invokes RPC, and checks device type in response.

methods.name: supportedaudioports
methods.description: Mocks getAudioOutputPorts and getAudioOutputPort, verifies supported audio ports list.

methods.name: supportedvideodisplays
methods.description: Mocks getVideoOutputPorts and verifies supported video display names.

methods.name: hostedid
methods.description: Mocks getHostEDID to return EDID data, and verifies base64 encoding in response.

methods.name: defaultresolution
methods.description: Mocks getDefaultVideoPortName, getDefaultResolution, and getVideoOutputPort to verify default resolution response.

methods.name: supportedresolutions
methods.description: Mocks getSupportedResolutions, create list of resolutions, and verify supportedResolutions array.

methods.name: supportedhdcp
methods.description: Mocks getHDCPProtocol, verifies HDCP version supported.

methods.name: audiocapabilities
methods.description: Mocks getAudioCapabilities, modifies capabilities, and verifies JSON list of supported audio features.

methods.name: ms12capabilities
methods.description: Mocks getMS12Capabilities, modifies capabilities, and verifies list in JSON.

methods.name: supportedms12audioprofiles
methods.description: Mocks getMS12AudioProfileList and checks supported profiles list.
